I am finishing my MSc in Mathematics and Foundations of Computer Science at the University of Oxford.

## Research interests

I am interested in the mathematical foundations of programming language semantics, particularly how we formalise and reason about program behaviour. More broadly, my interests include mathematical logic and its connections to theoretical computer science, including computability theory.

## Dissertation

My master's dissertation concerns contextual equivalence in simply typed lambda calculi: when can two terms be considered indistinguishable by the observations available to surrounding programs? [Read my dissertation (PDF)](files/dissertation.pdf)
